title: Emergency braking acceleration
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the acceleration magnitude during emergency braking using Newton's second law (a = F/m).

title: Velocity at trigger
description: Essential: Correctly states the car's speed (8 m/s) at the moment emergency braking is triggered.

title: Distance at trigger
description: Essential: Correctly states the distance to the obstacle (4 m) when emergency braking is triggered.

title: Average velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the average velocity for the entire 22m motion (22/3 m/s).

title: Two-stage kinematic setup
description: Important: Sets up correct kinematic equations for the two phases of motion (constant deceleration, then emergency braking).

title: Consistent sign convention
description: Important: Applies a consistent sign convention for acceleration/velocity in the kinematic equations.

title: Total displacement relation
description: Important: Recognizes that the sum of displacements in the two phases equals the total 22 m distance.

title: Unit analysis
description: Optional: Includes unit analysis or conversion in calculations.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses acceleration with incorrect sign in kinematic equations, leading to wrong velocity/distance.

title: Force misuse
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses the 12000 N resistance force in the first phase or misapplies Newton's second law.
